## About
Stratton Sport & Spine helps people overcome pain and perform better, from weekend warriors to competitive athletes. Our training covers chiropractic care, sports injury rehab and corrective exercise, so your care goes beyond the adjustment.
We don't just treat symptoms. We work to find what's causing the problem so you can heal, strengthen and keep moving. Our clinic on Heimer Rd has private treatment rooms, an exercise space in the center of the clinic and a massage room.
Patients have given us a 4.9 rating across 366 Google reviews. If something is holding you back, give us a call and we'll help you get started.

## Services
- Chiropractic care: Chiropractic adjustments as part of a plan that can include sports injury rehab and spine therapy.
- Dry needling: A technique for treating pain patterns, muscular dysfunction and other orthopedic problems.
- HIVAMAT deep oscillation: A gentle, non-invasive therapy that creates a kneading effect deep in damaged tissue to relieve pain and relax muscles.
- EPAT shockwave: Extracorporeal pulse activation technology, also known as shockwave therapy.
- Decompression and traction: Decompression and lumbar traction, plus motorized cervical traction.
- Active Release Technique: Soft tissue treatment for over-used muscles and other soft tissues.
- Graston Technique: Instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization.
- Kinesio Taping: Taping used to help reduce pain, support performance and prevent injury.
- Blood flow restriction (BFR) training: Training that uses a tourniquet on the upper limb to limit arterial inflow.
- NormaTec recovery system: Dynamic compression for recovery, for athletes at all levels.

## FAQ
Q: Do I have to be an athlete to come in?
A: No. We work with everyone from weekend warriors to competitive athletes, and with families too.

Q: Do you see kids?
A: Yes. One reviewer has brought her children in for regular adjustments since they were very young.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, the clinic is closed Saturday and Sunday. We're open Monday through Friday, with a shorter day on Friday.

Q: Where is the clinic?
A: We're on Heimer Rd in San Antonio, in Suite 345.
